info.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 24 at 3:05PM MDT until September 24 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
info.description:
* WHAT...Arroyo and small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.
* WHERE...Central Roosevelt County in east central New Mexico...
* WHEN...Until 600 PM MDT.
* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos. Water over roadways. Overflowing poor drainage areas.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 304 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This will cause arroyo and small stream flooding. Between 0.75 and 1.75 inches of rain have fallen. - Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the area. This additional rain, on top of rainfall received over the last 48 hours, will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Oasis State Park and Floyd. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

parameter.value: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 PM MDT THIS EVENING
